disclosure_text.name: disclosure_text
disclosure_text.default: 'Your saved journal records will be processed by the configured AI provider to create a private review report.'

ai_reports_terminal_fields.name: ai_reports_terminal_fields
ai_reports_terminal_fields.value: ("ai_report"."status" in ('queued', 'running') and "ai_report"."finished_at" is null) or ("ai_report"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled') and "ai_report"."finished_at" is not null)

ai_reports_queued_fields.name: ai_reports_queued_fields
ai_reports_queued_fields.value: "ai_report"."status" <> 'queued' or ("ai_report"."started_at" is null and "ai_report"."dispatched_at" is null and "ai_report"."lease_token" is null and "ai_report"."worker_id" is null and "ai_report"."lease_expires_at" is null)

ai_reports_running_fields.name: ai_reports_running_fields
ai_reports_running_fields.value: "ai_report"."status" <> 'running' or ("ai_report"."started_at" is not null and "ai_report"."lease_token" is not null and "ai_report"."worker_id" is not null and "ai_report"."lease_expires_at" is not null)

ai_reports_succeeded_analysis.name: ai_reports_succeeded_analysis
ai_reports_succeeded_analysis.value: "ai_report"."status" <> 'succeeded' or "ai_report"."deleted_at" is not null or "ai_report"."source_state" = 'invalidated' or "ai_report"."analysis_json" is not null

ai_reports_invalidated_body.name: ai_reports_invalidated_body
ai_reports_invalidated_body.value: "ai_report"."source_state" <> 'invalidated' or ("ai_report"."input_snapshot_encrypted" is null and "ai_report"."analysis_json" is null and "ai_report"."metrics_json" = '[]')

ai_usage_bucket_scope_owner_check.name: ai_usage_bucket_scope_owner_check
ai_usage_bucket_scope_owner_check.value: ("ai_usage_bucket"."scope" = 'global' and "ai_usage_bucket"."user_id" is null) or ("ai_usage_bucket"."scope" = 'user' and "ai_usage_bucket"."user_id" is not null)

ai_user_consent_state_check.name: ai_user_consent_state_check
ai_user_consent_state_check.value: ("ai_user_consent"."accepted_at" is not null) or ("ai_user_consent"."revoked_at" is not null)

alerts_single_shape.name: alerts_single_shape
alerts_single_shape.value: "alerts"."recurring_mode" is not null or ("alerts"."parent_id" is null and "alerts"."instance_number" = 1)

article_translation_ai_config_enabled_co.name: article_translation_ai_config_enabled_complete
article_translation_ai_config_enabled_co.value: not "article_translation_ai_config"."enabled" or ("article_translation_ai_config"."base_url" is not null and "article_translation_ai_config"."model" is not null and "article_translation_ai_config"."encrypted_api_key" is not null)

article_translation_job_lease_consistent.name: article_translation_job_lease_consistent
article_translation_job_lease_consistent.value: ("article_translation_job"."status" = 'running' and "article_translation_job"."lease_token" is not null and "article_translation_job"."worker_id" is not null and "article_translation_job"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("article_translation_job"."status" <> 'running' and "article_translation_job"."lease_token" is null and "article_translation_job"."worker_id" is null and "article_translation_job"."lease_expires_at" is null)

article_translation_job_finished_consist.name: article_translation_job_finished_consistent
article_translation_job_finished_consist.value: ("article_translation_job"."status" in ('queued', 'running') and "article_translation_job"."finished_at" is null) or ("article_translation_job"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'stale', 'cancelled') and "article_translation_job"."finished_at" is not null)

article_translation_runtime_lease_consis.name: article_translation_runtime_lease_consistent
article_translation_runtime_lease_consis.value: ("article_translation_runtime"."active_job_id" is null and "article_translation_runtime"."active_lease_token" is null and "article_translation_runtime"."active_lease_expires_at" is null) or ("article_translation_runtime"."active_job_id" is not null and "article_translation_runtime"."active_lease_token" is not null and "article_translation_runtime"."active_lease_expires_at" is not null)

investment_theses_active_content_check.name: investment_theses_active_content_check
investment_theses_active_content_check.value: "investment_theses"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR (nullif(btrim("investment_theses"."summary"), '') is not null AND nullif(btrim("investment_theses"."why_i_own_it"), '') is not null)

market_breadth_daily_counts_nonnegative.name: market_breadth_daily_counts_nonnegative
market_breadth_daily_counts_nonnegative.value: ("market_breadth_daily"."up4_count" is null or "market_breadth_daily"."up4_count" >= 0) and ("market_breadth_daily"."down4_count" is null or "market_breadth_daily"."down4_count" >= 0) and ("market_breadth_daily"."above40d_count" is null or "market_breadth_daily"."above40d_count" >= 0)

market_breadth_daily_percentages_bounded.name: market_breadth_daily_percentages_bounded
market_breadth_daily_percentages_bounded.value: ("market_breadth_daily"."up4_pct" is null or ("market_breadth_daily"."up4_pct" >= 0 and "market_breadth_daily"."up4_pct" <= 100)) and ("market_breadth_daily"."down4_pct" is null or ("market_breadth_daily"."down4_pct" >= 0 and "market_breadth_daily"."down4_pct" <= 100)) and ("market_breadth_daily"."above40d_pct" is null or ("market_breadth_daily"."above40d_pct" >= 0 and "market_breadth_daily"."above40d_pct" <= 100)) and ("market_breadth_daily"."coverage_pct" is null or ("market_breadth_daily"."coverage_pct" >= 0 and "market_breadth_daily"."coverage_pct" <= 100))

partner_links_pending_private.name: partner_links_pending_private
partner_links_pending_private.value: "partner_links"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL OR NOT ("partner_links"."user_a_shares_diaries" OR "partner_links"."user_b_shares_diaries" OR "partner_links"."user_a_shares_stock_notes" OR "partner_links"."user_b_shares_stock_notes")

post_translation_draft_snapshot_complete.name: post_translation_draft_snapshot_complete
post_translation_draft_snapshot_complete.value: ("post_translation"."draft_version" = 0 and "post_translation"."draft_title" is null and "post_translation"."draft_content" is null and "post_translation"."draft_source_revision" is null and "post_translation"."draft_source_hash" is null) or ("post_translation"."draft_version" > 0 and "post_translation"."draft_title" is not null and "post_translation"."draft_content" is not null and "post_translation"."draft_source_revision" is not null and "post_translation"."draft_source_hash" is not null)

post_translation_published_snapshot_comp.name: post_translation_published_snapshot_complete
post_translation_published_snapshot_comp.value: ("post_translation"."published_version" = 0 and "post_translation"."published_title" is null and "post_translation"."published_content" is null and "post_translation"."published_source_revision" is null and "post_translation"."published_source_hash" is null and "post_translation"."published_at" is null) or ("post_translation"."published_version" > 0 and "post_translation"."published_title" is not null and "post_translation"."published_content" is not null and "post_translation"."published_source_revision" is not null and "post_translation"."published_source_hash" is not null and "post_translation"."published_at" is not null)

post_translation_review_snapshot_consist.name: post_translation_review_snapshot_consistent
post_translation_review_snapshot_consist.value: ("post_translation"."reviewed_draft_version" is null and "post_translation"."reviewed_at" is null) or ("post_translation"."reviewed_draft_version" is not null and "post_translation"."reviewed_at" is not null and "post_translation"."reviewed_draft_version" > 0)

post_translation_published_requires_curr.name: post_translation_published_requires_current_review
post_translation_published_requires_curr.value: "post_translation"."status" <> 'published' or ("post_translation"."published_version" > 0 and "post_translation"."draft_version" > 0 and "post_translation"."reviewed_at" is not null and "post_translation"."reviewed_draft_version" = "post_translation"."draft_version")

post_translation_source_hash_shapes.name: post_translation_source_hash_shapes
post_translation_source_hash_shapes.value: ("post_translation"."draft_source_hash" is null or "post_translation"."draft_source_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$') and ("post_translation"."published_source_hash" is null or "post_translation"."published_source_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{32}$')

price_alerts_moving_average_direction_ch.name: price_alerts_moving_average_direction_check
price_alerts_moving_average_direction_ch.value: ("price_alerts"."type" = 'MOVING_AVG' and "price_alerts"."moving_average_direction" is not null) or ("price_alerts"."type" <> 'MOVING_AVG' and "price_alerts"."moving_average_direction" is null)

research_revision_approval_fields.name: research_revision_approval_fields
research_revision_approval_fields.value: "research_revision"."review_status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("research_revision"."approved_by_snapshot" is not null and "research_revision"."approved_at" is not null)

research_runtime_lease_fields.name: research_runtime_lease_fields
research_runtime_lease_fields.value: ("research_runtime_state"."active_attempt_id" is null and "research_runtime_state"."active_lease_token" is null and "research_runtime_state"."active_lease_expires_at" is null) or ("research_runtime_state"."active_attempt_id" is not null and "research_runtime_state"."active_lease_token" is not null and "research_runtime_state"."active_lease_expires_at" is not null)

thesis_reviews_reflection_check.name: thesis_reviews_reflection_check
thesis_reviews_reflection_check.value: nullif(btrim("thesis_reviews"."what_improved"), '') is not null OR nullif(btrim("thesis_reviews"."what_deteriorated"), '') is not null OR nullif(btrim("thesis_reviews"."what_changed"), '') is not null

trade_plans_zone_order_v1_check.name: trade_plans_zone_order_v1_check
trade_plans_zone_order_v1_check.value: "trade_plans"."entry_zone_low" is null or "trade_plans"."entry_zone_high" is null or "trade_plans"."entry_zone_low" <= "trade_plans"."entry_zone_high"
